Explanation:  
The question asks for the manager of the team that won the first Football League after the death of Queen Victoria, which occurred in January 1901. The predicted answer claims Alex Mackie of Sunderland won the 1901–02 title. However, the ground truth states Tom Watson was the manager of Liverpool F.C. in 1901. Historical records confirm Liverpool won the 1900–01 Football League season (the first finished after Queen Victoria's death in January 1901), under Tom Watson. Sunderland won the following (1901–02) season, managed by Alex Mackie. Therefore, the predicted answer does not include the ground truth (Tom Watson, Liverpool in 1901).

Decision: FALSE
